// security: npm audit reports 3 remaining highs, all inside next@16.2.11's own dependency tree:
postcss 8.4.31 (exact pin) and sharp 0.34.5 (optional). 16.2.11 IS npm's `latest` — there
is no stable Next that ships patched versions yet, `npm audit fix --force` would DOWNGRADE
next to 9.3.3, and npm `overrides` are silently ignored for both (verified on a clean tree).
Neither is reachable here: postcss runs at build time over our own CSS, and next/image is
used ONLY for two local logo files with no images.remotePatterns configured, so sharp never
processes attacker-supplied bytes. TRIPWIRE: adding images.remotePatterns — i.e. letting
next/image optimize baker/customer uploads — makes the sharp libvips CVEs reachable and this
must be re-assessed. See SEC-WEB-2 in spattoo-docs/security/spattoo-web-SECURITY_ACTION_PLAN.md.
